title: notoseris wilsonii
intro: Notoseris wilsonii, commonly known as the Wilson's Notoseris, is a plant species in the family Compositae, native to China. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Wilson's Notoseris are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibiting immunomodulatory effects, and its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and terpenoids, are responsible for its pharmacological properties. Further research is needed to fully elucidate the bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential of Notoseris wilsonii.
